pagerbot: PAGE | sev2 | auth-edge-mirroring | Unusual session header mirroring across regions detected. Automated detector triggered 320 duplicated session-ids in 5m. Investigate -> <https://incidents.internal/4971234567>

emma-oncall: on it, joining bridge now. creating incident-bridge (zoom://bridge-4971234567). assigning myself as bridge lead.

jon-sec: quick question — do we have any evidence of tokens exfiltration or external egress?

niya-sre: short answer: maybe. seeing identical x-session header values across different edge hosts and regions within seconds. sample logs below (sanitized):

```
EDGE_LOG 2026-03-17T01:02:33Z src=edge-a region=us-west path=/v1/chat headers={"x-session":"sesh-4f7b1a","x-forwarded-for":"10.0.0.1"}
EDGE_LOG 2026-03-17T01:02:34Z src=edge-b region=eu-west path=/v1/chat headers={"x-session":"sesh-4f7b1a","x-forwarded-for":"52.14.2.3"}
EDGE_LOG 2026-03-17T01:02:35Z src=edge-c region=ap-south path=/v1/chat headers={"x-session":"sesh-4f7b1a","x-forwarded-for":"3.5.6.7"}
```

niya-sre: that pattern looks like sticky session metadata is being mirrored into our log stream (logshipper) before token redaction. could be config drift in the edge proxy where header rewrite was disabled.

jon-sec: ok please do not purge those logs yet — we need them for forensics. but stop sending them to any external buckets. action: block outbound from logshipper-prod to external S3/buckets and rotate the svc account used by the log forwarder.

emma-oncall: running commands now — disabling log forwarder job `logshipper-prod-2` (kubectl scale job/logshipper-prod-2 --replicas=0). pausing external drains.

infra-bot: action taken: `logshipper-prod-2` scaled to 0. egress rule applied to block `logshipper-prod` -> external-s3 (rule id: egress-block-497123).

jon-sec: start immediate rotation: rotate `svc-log-forwarder` IAM key and swap KMS alias for logs-encrypt-prod. also create short-lived credentials for any backfilled reingestion. post once rotated.

emma-oncall: rotating svc key now. running `rotate-service-key svc-log-forwarder --force` — ETA ~2m. will keep runbook step notes in the bridge.

sofia-cs: do we have customer impact? are any requests failing or data exposed to customers? I can draft a heads-up if needed.

niya-sre: minimal observed 502 retries for a subset of requests while we scaled the forwarder; no large customer-facing errors reported in the last 10m. risk: leaked header values in logs that were forwarded externally between 00:55-01:03 UTC. need to identify which customers (if any) had session values present.

jon-sec: agree. containment first. then scope. we should assume sensitive session ids may be in the external bucket during that window. steps: 1) block egress (done) 2) rotate keys (in progress) 3) inventory buckets and set retention/erase flag on suspect objects 4) legal + cs consult before customer notification.

darren-legal: preserve chain of custody. do not delete logs until we capture manifests for each object. we will need a scope doc before any external disclosure. legal on standby.

sofia-cs: understood — I'll prepare a customer impact template but hold sending. will prepare internal FAQ for support engineers.

emma-oncall: svc key rotated successfully. KMS alias swap initiated. infra-bot confirms rotation id 8c9f.

infra-bot: KMS alias `logs-encrypt-prod` rotated to new key `arn:aws:kms:...:key/0a1b2c3d4e`. rotation complete.

niya-sre: running a targeted search across archived buckets for `sesh-4f7b1a` and other duplicated session prefixes. will output findings to the bridge in 10m.

jon-sec: set severity to P1 if we find external exposures with customer identifiers. for now keep as P2 while we assess.

emma-oncall: triage timeline will be in the incident doc: https://incidents.internal/4971234567/doc. next update in 15m or sooner if anything changes.

sofia-cs: prepping internal comms. draft ready, will post to #customer-ops when legal gives the go.

darren-legal: acknowledged. I'll review the scope doc once niya posts results. hold any external notifications.

jon-sec: thanks team. owners: emma (bridge lead), niya (forensics), jon (sec lead), sofia (customer comms), darren (legal). react with :thumbsup: when you see this.

emma-oncall: :thumbsup: I'm on the bridge.

niya-sre: :thumbsup: running searches now.

infra-bot: note: saved runbook snapshot `runbooks/edge-log-mirroring/2026-03-17-497123` for post-incident review.

pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATED | 4971234567 | status=contained actions=egress-block,svc-key-rotate,kms-swap

emma-oncall: closing interim update. will follow with forensics dump in the bridge in ~12m.

jon-sec: high-level checklist: 1) confirm objects with session headers 2) manifest and preserve 3) evaluate customer identifiers 4) legal review 5) decide customer notification 6) remediation (edge proxy config fix + deploy)

niya-sre: note: pushing hotfix to edge proxy to re-enable header-redact middleware in staging for testing before prod deploy.

emma-oncall: all right — team remain on bridge until we have the scope. update soon.
